description: React component for an expandable role card in a job/career exploration app, displaying role details, compatibility score, skills, responsibilities, and allowing setting the role as a target.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, handling null/undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Safely converts a value to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out non-arrays.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Converts an array of strings into bulleted sentences with proper punctuation.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a number to the 0-100 range, rounding to nearest integer.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts role ID from role object with fallback properties.

methods.name: roleSalaryFromRole
methods.description: Extracts salary range string from role object considering multiple backend sources.

methods.name: roleExperienceFromRole
methods.description: Extracts experience range string from role object.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts and deduplicates persona skills from various nested schema locations.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Normalizes a skill string to lowercase trimmed form.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds intersection of persona skills and required skills, returning matched skills.
